name: engine_bsfc_bore_stroke_afr
title: Engine bsfc from bore, stroke and air-fuel ratio (MCI TP7 Ex2)
summary: Teaching exercise: a 12-cylinder four-stroke engine described by bore, stroke, speed, air-fuel ratio and volumetric, mechanical and combustion efficiencies. Computes the air and fuel mass flows, the brake and indicated specific fuel consumptions (g/kWh) and the unburnt-hydrocarbon flow per kWh of shaft work.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP séance 7, exercise 2 (engine efficiencies and specific fuel consumptions), 2019.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of EX_2_PNG_2019.EES (20 records). compare_solution.py --ees-units: 20 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); max rel diff 3.13e-04 on rho_su and the flows derived from it (EES real Air vs CoolProp ideal-gas Air). M_dot_f, bsfc, isfc, isfc_bis (no stored record) check by isfc=isfc_bis and bsfc=isfc/eta_m.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of EX_2_PNG_2019.EES (20 records decoded by ees_extract.py; EES X10.589)
verification.notes: Unit system of the original SI MASS DEG KPA C KJ converted by hand (ees_import.md §6); the g/kWh factors changed accordingly. System square 24x24, largest block 1; the converted model solves with the converted stored values as guesses.
